text: Felix Dustin Fletcher, an Electrical Engineer in the Test and Evaluation team, had an anomalous week. The UEBA system flagged the week due to evidence from triggered rules [R4] and [R5]. Specifically, Felix visited job-search sites 34 times, which is far above their typical range and also above the peer range for same-role peers. Additionally, Felix performed 129 file operations, which is clearly above their usual range and also above the peer range.
